product.title: Cusco by Night: Planetarium Cusco, Dinner, and Pisco Sour

description.text: In Cusco, this evening outing pairs Planetarium Cusco stargazing with illuminated historic-center landmarks, a traditional dinner, and one Pisco Sour. Groups are limited to eight, and hotel pickup and drop-off are included; planetarium entry is listed as a separate on-site amount. The published route keeps the night on the plaza, the planetarium, and dinner rather than a self-guided bar hop. Inca constellation commentary is the stargazing core when skies are clear. The format suits visitors who want a guided tasting evening without assembling tickets independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cusco, and the itinerary stays on Plaza de Armas, Planetarium Cusco, and the historic center that shape this night outing rather than a daytime ruin circuit or a Sacred Valley day.
